<user_query>
Other explorers are investigating different slices of the same subsystem in parallel. Don't try to cover everything. Focus on your assigned angle and go deep. Work strictly read-only. Do not modify files, refs, index, objects, or working tree.

Repository: /private/var/folders/11/m_kwnqr97632l_cjt0mhytvh0000gn/T/pstack-corpus-ur5cbW/20-PROMPT-HOW-READONLY-EXPLORERS-r1/cursor/work

## Question
> How does this repository's git storage work end to end? Cover how HEAD, the refs, the index, and the object store fit together to produce README.md in the working tree.

## Your Exploration Angle
Analyze .git/index and README.md's concrete index entry using read-only commands. Explain the index's role as proposed next tree and checkout cache, its path/mode/blob/stat fields, stage numbers, and how Git compares HEAD-to-index and index-to-working-tree. Identify README.md's actual indexed object and whether all three states agree. Leave detailed refs and object internals to other explorers.

## Output

### Components Found
The key types, services, classes, and abstractions. For each: name, file path, and a one-sentence description of what it does.

### Flow
The execution flow step by step. For each step: what command/storage lookup runs, what file it's in, what it does, what it calls or resolves next. Include the data that flows between steps.

### Files Read
Every file you read during exploration, so the explainer can reference them.

### Boundaries
Where this subsystem connects to other parts of the repository. The inputs and outputs.

### Non-Obvious Things
Anything surprising, historically motivated, or easy to get wrong. Things that look like they should work one way but work another.

### Open Questions
Anything you couldn't fully trace or understand. Be honest about gaps.
</user_query>
I'll stay read-only and focus on the index: README.md's cache entry, then how Git compares that entry to HEAD and the working tree.

input.command:
export GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS=0
git rev-parse --is-inside-work-tree
echo "--- HEAD ---"
git rev-parse HEAD
echo "--- symbolic HEAD ---"
git symbolic-ref -q HEAD || true
echo "--- status porcelain (no locks) ---"
git --no-optional-locks status --porcelain=v1 -b --untracked-files=all
echo "--- ls-files stage+debug ---"
git --no-optional-locks ls-files --stage --debug
echo "--- index file stat ---"
ls -la .git/index .git/HEAD README.md 2>&1
echo "--- file types ---"
file .git/index README.md
echo "--- wc ---"
wc -c .git/index README.md
echo "--- git version ---"
git --version
input.description: Read-only git HEAD, index, and README metadata
